abstract: The impact of voltage harmonics on a power system can be minimized by using an active power line conditioner (APLC) to inject distortion-canceling currents. This paper presents a new method that is based on evolutionary computation to decide where an APLC should be placed for maximum performance. The simulation result verifies the validity of the new method.

articleTitle: Study on the fuzzy control technique for the power ultrasonic instrument
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)

articleTitle: Stair-like modular multivariable DMC controller and its application in atmospheric pyrochemical furnace
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper introduces a modular multivariable dynamic matrix controller (DMC). Using the modular stratified structure, it assigns the goals into each of the control module according their importance, and uses a stair-like control strategy to avoid the complex calculation of model predictive control, not only simplifying the calculation but also making it more robust. We apply the controller to the atmospheric pyrochemical furnace for temperature control.

articleTitle: A controller with impulse force moment design for two-links flexible manipulator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A method of impulse force moment control is established for vertical planar two-links flexible manipulators. The elastic vibrations of two-link manipulators are decoupled from the flexible manipulator. The asymptotic stability of joint trajectory tracking control are proved. The simulation results show that, the elastic vibrations of two links manipulator are restrained when the tip trajectory of manipulator is being traced with this method.

articleTitle: An approach to nonlinear fault diagnosis based on neural network adaptive observer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A fault detection method based on neural network online approximation structure for uncertain nonlinear systems is presented. A neural network observer is used to learn the nonlinear fault functions to monitor the abnormal behavior of the dynamic system. When system faults occur, the online learning structure can approximate all possible unknown faults, then the faults are identified and accommodated. The uniformly ultimately bounded stability of the closed-loop error system is guaranteed by Lyapunov stability theory and the weights are tuned without need of persistency of excitation.

articleTitle: Variable-step BP training algorithm with an adaptive momentum term
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper proposes a new variable-step BP training algorithm which can overcome some disadvantages of the traditional BP training algorithm such as slow convergent speed and tendency of getting the local minima. In the new method, a nonlinear property term is introduced and its intensity coefficient is constructed as an adaptive nonlinear function, which processes the temperature ascending and temperature descending strategy. The simulation results show the efficiency of the new method.

articleTitle: Improve on recognition algorithms of RoboCup
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper proposes some solutions to improve on recognition algorithms of RoboCup, which is including methods to improve recognition efficiency, recognition precision, and to restrain effect caused by reflex. Multiresolution scanning and dynamic window technique can be used to improve efficiency and precision. In order to restrain effect of reflex, gray-level threshold will be self-adaptive. This paper also proposes a method helping to geometric calibration of image.

articleTitle: Neural network output feedback control for uncertain robot
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A neural network output feedback control scheme is proposed for the trajectory tracking of uncertain robot manipulators without measuring joint velocities. First, a nonlinear sliding observer based on a neural network is presented to estimate the joint velocities. Then, an observer-based neural network output feedback controller is proposed. The overall closed-loop system composed of a robot, an observer, and a controller is shown to be robust. Besides, it has been proven that both velocity estimation errors and trajectory tracking errors asymptotically tend to zero, and the estimation errors of neural network weights are uniformly bounded.

articleTitle: Research of the control strategy of burning system of industrial oil-poor boiler based on self-learning fuzzy neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The primary fuel of an oil-poor boiler is residuum oil or drop-off oil. Based on the discrete parameter of thermal technology the burning process is influenced by factors such as quality, pressure, temperature of oil and fluctuation of load, etc. The burning system of an oil-poor boiler is a complex controlled structure featuring nonlinear, multivariable, large detention, and strong disturbance. An accurate mathematical model is difficult to construct and the required control effect is hard to achieve with the routine control strategy. In this paper, a self-learning fuzzy neural network control strategy for the burning system of an oil-poor boiler is presented, and the steam pressure, steam load, oxide content and structured MIMO system fabric model are considered in detail. Experiment result obtained shows that this burning system control strategy is robust with improved stability.

articleTitle: A novel survival of the fittest genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Considering the relationship between the variety of evolution population and evolution times, a novel closed crossing avoidance strategy is put forth in this paper. Based on it, a novel survival of the fittest genetic algorithm is present. The algorithm can avoid close breeding effectively and the thought of survival of the fittest is externalized. It has been proved that the algorithm can converge to an optimal solution globally. Simulation shows that the algorithm present in this paper is an efficient contrast with the simple genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: RBFNN based direct adaptive control of MIMO nonlinear system and its application to a distillation column
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In this paper, a RBFNN (radial basis function neural network) based direct adaptive controller for a MIMO nonlinear system is designed. The tuning law of weights of the neural network is derived from a selected Lyapunov function. So the stability of the closed loop and convergence of weights are guaranteed. The design method is applied to the quality control of a distillation column. The dual-point control strategy is adopted instead of single-point control. A simulation is illustrated to show the validity of the designed controller.

articleTitle: Matrix bounds for the coupled algebraic Riccati equation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In this note, we propose lower and upper matrix bounds for the positive semidefinite solution of the unified coupled algebraic Riccati equation (UCARE). Using the results of this note, computational algorithms to solve the UCARE can be established.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent robot controller for a steel plate by line heating and cooling
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Based on expert systems on a steel plate, an intelligent robot controller for steel plate line heating and cooling on a large complex curved surface is researched and designed, and hardware and software systems of the intelligent robot controller are described in detail. As a result, the designed robot controller has a good function and improves efficiency in shipbuilding manufacture.

articleTitle: Further discussion of Hopfield neural network based DC drive system identification and control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In (Wang Lei et al., 1999) a Hopfield neural network (HNN) based linear system parameter identification scheme is discussed under the assumption that HNN inputs are the detected system states delayed by sensors. In (Wang Lei et al., 1999) the Hopfield neural network (HNN) is used for model reference adaptive controller design and its convergence character is proved. In (Wang Lei et al., 1999) the HNN is used for multi-variable system controller design. In all these papers, the derived scheme is used for identification and control of AC and DC drive systems. The simulation results prove the validity of the scheme. In this paper, the general framework of DC drive system identification and control is given. The simulation results are generally discussed.

articleTitle: Pervasive computing infrastructure for ITS
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Vehicle electronic systems and roadside equipment are the two important foundations for intelligent transportation systems (ITS). From the data exchange and scheduling points of view, we look at the development trend of ITS and applications of pervasive computing infrastructures. The use of spontaneous networking (SN) as an appropriate infrastructure is presented and analyzed in detail. Finally, several SN research projects including ours are described briefly.

articleTitle: An input-training neural network based nonlinear principal component analysis approach for fault diagnosis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In this paper some existing problems in the linear principal component analysis methodology are discussed first. A nonlinear principal component analysis methodology based upon input-training neural network is presented for process fault diagnosis. The learning algorithm of input-training neural network is modified to improve its learning speed and avoid oscillation during learning. Then, input-training neural network and BP neural network are used to estimate the nonlinear principal component scores. Fault detection and diagnosis is performed by means of statistical methods like Hotelling's T/sup 2/ and Q. Finally, the simulation research to continuous stirred tank reactor is performed to show its advantages in extracting the nonlinear features compared with the linear principal component analysis methodology.

articleTitle: Identification of optimization injection allocation model in polymer flooding
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The mathematical model of produced oil decline ratio and produced water increasing ratio in polymer is established and recurrence partial least square method of parameter identification is studied in this paper. In order to realize optimization injection allocation of polymer, the correlative analyze method of parameter identification about monthly water content increment is researched, and the method of joint identification connected parameters using above two methods is raised.

articleTitle: Optimizing virtual environment for micro operation using genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A genetic algorithm to optimize the virtual micro operation environment is put forward in this paper. Firstly, the optical model for microscopic imaging is introduced. Secondly, the background and reasons of using the genetic algorithm are discussed. Furthermore, a genetic algorithm is designed to seek the mapping between the spread parameter of the microscope and Z-axis coordinates. Finally, this genetic algorithm is used to optimize the virtual environment for micro operation with the features of the microscopic image. The genetic algorithm is proved to be effective by some experiments.

articleTitle: Analysis and summarization of load distribution method for hot continuous rolling mill
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The load distribution of hot continuous rolling is the foundation of optimizing for process control. In this paper, equal load distribution and energy consume method were introduced. The advantages of equal load distribution method invented by our country was illustrated by comparing other methods, at the same time the feasibility to put into use in hot continuous rolling was put forward.

articleTitle: A novel processing for multiple gases detection
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: It is difficult to detect multiple gases by single chemical sensor because of nonlinear and complicated relations between multiple gas and surface of sensitive materials. In this paper, the technology of multisensor data fusion is applied to detect multiple gases. It is presented a novel detection method based on multiobjective genetic algorithm(MOGA) for analyzing and distinguishing each component's concentration in multiple gases. The multigas detection is transformed to multiobjective optimization problem. In order to avoid premature convergence, sharing function is introduced to maintain the diversity of the population. The theory of multiple gases detection is described in detail. The experimental results are given and the results demonstrate the mechanism proposed in this paper is effective.

articleTitle: A HCP-net for the unit commitment problem with time-dependent constraints
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A CP-net (colored Petri net) of an individual unit in dynamic programming approach for the unit commitment problem with time-dependent constraints is proposed. The CP-net is compared with the low-level net for the same problem and advantages for CP-nets in practical applications are obtained. A hierarchical CP-net is used to illustrate the parallel computing of different subnets of units in a group, and the HCP-net model of the problem will improve greatly the efficiency of algorithm for the same problem.

articleTitle: A fuzzy matter-element scheme multi-objective optimization method based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper presents a fuzzy matter-element optimization method for a machine scheme based on a genetic algorithm. For example, for designing a drive scheme, at first, the fuzzy matter-element is applied to build a model for the drive scheme. Then, the adaptive macroevolution genetic algorithm is applied to resolve this model during which the real number coding method is used to code chromosomes for the drive scheme. During the process of resolving the model, the rhombic thought method has been combined with the genetic algorithm organically. The paper discusses the key technology of the genetic algorithm for designing the drive scheme in detail. At last, this method is applied to design a drive scheme and a satisfying result is obtained, so the method is verified to be valid by this example.

articleTitle: The optimization of genetic algorithm control parameters
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In the paper, methods of optimizing genetic algorithm control parameters are presented, including the method of adjusting crossover probability and mutation probability, the dynamic convergence rule and the method of determining the optimal population size. All the methods can be applied to enhancing genetic algorithm running efficiency and preventing premature convergence.

articleTitle: RBF neural network with optimal selection cluster algorithm and its application
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In this paper, the RBF neural network (RBFNN) is used as a modeling framework to solve the identification problem of nonlinear systems. First, it is proposed a kind of optimal selection cluster algorithm. By this algorithm, it is optimally gained the hidden layer node number of RBFNN in terms of input samples. At the same time, the initial parameter values of RBF are obtained. Then, the parameters of RBF are estimated by the gradient algorithm with momentum terms, and the weights of RBFNN are identified by the recursive least square algorithm. The above two algorithms are alternately iterated. By the above hybrid algorithms, it is not only raised identification precision of RBFNN, but also improved the generalization property of the net. The validity of the scheme described is proved.

articleTitle: Research on robot control system based on PC
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Aiming at the close architecture of robot controller, a design for the robot control system based on PC is presented in this paper. The key technique of the software design is discussed and the application of OpenGL graphic simulation of this system is also introduced.

articleTitle: Model identification and PID control of long time-delay processes
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A relay feedback identification auto-tuning of PID/PI controller is proposed in this paper, which is capable of controlling long time-delay processes. The real process is approximated via FOPDT or SOPDT models, whose parameters are specified through a modified relay feedback identification method. Applying the zero-pole cancellation principle, the PID/PI controller is tuned according to the specified amplitude and phase margins. Model identification and controller parameter tuning are done online without much influence on the normal operation. This algorithm also has many other advantages such as a fast setpoint response, strong robustness and good disturbance rejection ability.

articleTitle: Stability analysis for interval descriptor systems: a matrix inequalities approach
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper considers the stability analysis and quadratic stabilization problem for a class of interval descriptor systems. It derives a sufficient condition for the interval descriptor systems to be quadratically admissible. Then, the conditions for the interval descriptor systems to be quadratically stabilizable are established. Two numerical examples are used to illustrate the main results.

articleTitle: An improved decentralized robust adaptive control strategy of robot manipulators
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: An improved decentralized robust adaptive control strategy for trajectory tracking of robot manipulators with uncertainties is proposed in this paper, which utilized the idea of Ming Liu (1999). This controller consists of a linear PD controller and a nonlinear adaptive feedback as well as a cubic compensation term The control law has the formation of decentralization and overcomes uncertainty effects such as frictions and external disturbance. The simulation comparison of 2-DOF rigid robot is presented to show effectiveness, feasibility and superiority of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: A kind of practical fuzzy clustering
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Fuzzy clustering is one of the most important fuzzy techniques. This paper adopts a relational degree as similarity measurement between objects, and thus forms relational clustering which may find wide applications in social systems and economic systems. At the same time, this paper presents a kind of recomposed fuzzy clustering which can be used to execute the task of partitioning and evaluation for a lot of objects in many systems effectively.

articleTitle: A novel approach based on support vector machine to forecasting the quality of friction welding
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The traditional quality evaluation methods for friction welding joints suffer from problems of complicated testing process, difficult evaluating criteria, low accurate ratio and off-line implementation. In this study, a new approach of computation intelligence using support vector machine (SVM) arithmetic to predict the quality of the welding bond is presented. The features from technique parameters are directly extracted and a radial basis function (RBF) is selected as kernel function to construct a SVM classifier. The utilization quality or the most important property in service is acted on as a mere criterion to precisely evaluate the performance of FRW bond, which decides the classification rules for SVMs. The new technique performs better than conventional evaluation methods with advantages of high efficiency, lower cost and easy implementation online. It is also proved that the SVM classifier is superior to RBF neural networks in prediction precision and generalization. The approach provides a novel technique for nondestructive properties evaluation of friction welding joints.

articleTitle: Multiple model estimation represented by Bayesian networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Multiple Model Estimation (MME) in hybrid systems, as a powerful approach to adaptive estimation, has been widely applied in a great deal of attention due to its unique power to handle problems with both structural and parametric uncertainties. In this paper, multiple well-known methods in MME are represented in the form of Bayesian Networks (BN), which is widely used in artificial intelligence. The discussion implies that MME may be a special case of BN.

articleTitle: H/sub 2/ performance analysis and control for discrete-time descriptor systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Addresses the problems of H/sub 2/ performance analysis and control for discrete-time descriptor systems. First, the existence and uniqueness of the solutions of two discrete-time generalized Lyapunov equations are studied. By means of the above equations, the state-space method for computing H/sub 2/ norm for the systems is given. Furthermore, a H/sub 2/ static output feedback controller is designed based on the above analysis. Finally, numerical examples are given to illustrate the main results.

articleTitle: The implementation of virtual machining of the prosthetic socket based on OpenGL
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The paper presents an implementation method of Virtual Machining of the prosthetic socket based on Open Graphics Library (OpenGL), discusses an arithmetic of constructing prosthetic socket model and confirming model and tool paths. It improves the function of Prosthetic Socket CAD/CAM system.

articleTitle: A research on Web resources automatic classification using SVMs
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: With the rapid growth of Web information, text categorization has become an important research field for the management of Internet information. Most of the existing methods are based on traditional statistics, which provides a conclusion only for the situation where sample size is tending to infinity. So they may not work well in practical case with limited samples and easily lead to the problem of over-fitting. These papers theoretical analyze the reason of over-fitting and introduce its condition as well as the method to solve it. We introduce SVMs, a method to avoid over-fitting, which is based on statistical learning theory matching the limited number of Internet news examples.

articleTitle: Stability analysis for a kind of multi-variable linear systems with delayed state
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Based on Lyapunov's theory of stability, a equation of sufficient condition for multivariable linear delayed systems with delayed independent stabilization is derived and another forms are also given. Based on this, several simple criterions for judging independent stabilization from linear delayed system are presented. We also discuss the exponential stability for delayed system and also provide the sufficient condition of exponential stability with any appointed convergent rate and its corresponding deductions. Using these conditions, we can choose a set of suitable parameters to reduce the conservation. By calculating and being compared with methods of the literature, the results show that our methods have less conservation.

articleTitle: A conceptual communication model based on HOONet in general open controllers
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Communication is one of the important functions in the middle layer of the 3-layered typical architecture of open controllers. Most of the realized communication is based on the OSI Reference Model which may affect system performance if the communication behaves in local ranges. In order to improve system performance and to keep the reliability of communication, the hierarchical object-oriented Petri net (HOONet) is modified and time information is attached to it. Then the simplified synchronous and asynchronous communication model is completed based on the modified HOONet.

articleTitle: Environment modeling based on AVBN method for mobile robot
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The paper provides an environment-modeling method based on AVBN for a mobile robot. The environment model is illustrated as an AVBN (approximate Voronoi boundary network) constructed by enlarging the obstacle raster. Such topological model's connectivity is ensured by adding virtual obstacles. The number of AVBN's nodes is less than that of the generalized Voronoi diagram method, so the complexity of the path planning problem is reduced largely in comparison with the last method.

articleTitle: Eigenstructure assignment for continuous time-variant uncertain system based on LMI
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The eigenstructure assignment method for a continuous time-variant uncertain system based on linear matrix inequality (LMI) is investigated in this paper. The result can be combined with other LMIs for more system indices. All these LMIs can form a satisfying controller design method for continuous time-variant uncertain systems.

articleTitle: Modeling production processing system with Arena4.0
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Because of the complexity of practical production system and the uncertainty of many decision variables, simulation is an important tool of decision under uncertainty. This paper studies the modeling method of production processing system with Arena4.0. This model includes some sub models: purchasing model, processing model, matching model, sale model and storage model etc. Modularity, friendly interface and easy operation are characteristics of the system. In order to optimize resources and improve efficiency, decision maker can modify parameters of the system based on practice and make real time dynamic decision in the course of simulation.

articleTitle: Micro-scratch inspection system for semiconductor process by two-ways laser scattering method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: CMP (Chemical Mechanical Polishing) is a key technology in semiconductor processing. However, when a problem arises in the polishing conditions, scratches are caused and yield can deteriorate drastically. We study the characteristic figure of scratch the depth of which is extremely shallow compared with width. We propose a 2-way illumination comparative discrimination method. By experiment, we obtain a good discrimination ratio between scratch and particle on unpatterned dummy wafers.

articleTitle: The navigation principle and algorithm of vehicular dead reckoning system with differential compass
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A differential compass (composed of tachometers in ABS) instead of a rate gyro has been adopted for direction navigation information of vehicles in this paper. The system/observation equation of the vehicular dead reckoning (DR) system with a differential compass (DC) is established and the navigation algorithm based on a two-steps adaptive kalman filter is constructed to obtain the dynamic parameters of vehicle for real-time navigation. The field running experiment shows that satisfactory accuracy is achieved by the DR navigation system with DC and its navigation algorithm proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Application of theorem proving to automated diagnoses field
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Presents a theorem proving system constructed by Prolog. Based on the descriptions, data and assumptions of logical circuit board (devices), the system can diagnose malfunction of devices automatically, proving whether some component works well.

articleTitle: Petri net-based design method of digital circuits
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The traditional design method of digital circuits isn't very appropriate for the design of parallel controller. This paper presents a Petri net based design method of digital circuits: first model the problem with Petri net, then analysis and control the model. Thus the Petri net's control model of the system is achieved. We can describe the Petri net's control model with hardware description language and achieve the source file. Through electronics design automation software development tools, the source file is compiled, simulated, fit design and download to the device. Finally the hardware implementation of the controller of dining philosophers problem is presented.

articleTitle: Finite time sliding mode control for time delay systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In this paper, a terminal sliding mode control is proposed for the finite time convergence of general input-delay systems. The proposed sliding surface is given recursively by the state variables of a predictor which compensates for the input delay of the systems. The global stability of the closed-loop system is guaranteed and finite time convergence of all the signals in the system, including the control law, is proved. Although the proposed control strategy is sliding mode based, the control signal is continuous except at a single discontinuous point. The chattering phenomenon commonly associated with sliding mode control does not occur.

articleTitle: Manufacture & management information system of mine enterprise
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The speciality of manufacture & management system of mine enterprise is analysed. The design principle of the system is discussed. With an example, the main functions of manufacture & management information system of mine enterprise are introduced in detail.

articleTitle: A new method measuring electrical conductivity of nutrient solutions on-line
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: For the problem of measuring the electrical conductivity of nutrient solutions in a closed soilless growing system in greenhouse agriculture, a method fitting the model of an electrical conductivity sensor step by step is put forward. The method of sensor calibration and nutrition solution measurement on-line is constructed also. The process of measuring electrical conductivity is introduced in the paper. The application results demonstrate that the model constructed in the paper fits the performance well, and the new method can be widely used in engineering in a concise way.

articleTitle: The predictive control of the liquid level of the pre-fractionating tower of a catalyzing reforming plant
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: As a common predictive control method, the Dynamic Matrix Control (DMC) algorithm has been widely studied and developed in the last two decades. It has been successfully applied in many chemical/petrochemical plants, where it has an excellent performance. For the control problem of the liquid level of the pre-fractionating tower in the catalyzing reforming plant in a refinery, this paper presents the system identification of the dynamic predictive model and the application of the DMC algorithm, besides the improvement of the algorithm to speed up the controller and make it more suitable for computer use.

articleTitle: Product quality control and its application to the flash smelting process
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Surveys the research on industrial product quality control problems combined with the flash smelting furnace's modeling and control of Jinchuan Group Co. Ltd. The steady-state and dynamic product quality models, and quality inverse models and quality control models of the furnace are studied using neural network and fuzzy logic methods.

articleTitle: An intelligent system for real-time monitoring and fault predicting
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)

articleTitle: Output feedback adaptive robust control algorithm applied to ship steering autopilot with uncertain nonlinear system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A state feedback adaptive robust control algorithm is first presented for a ship steering autopilot with uncertain nonlinear system based on known parameter bound of the system and known bound of input disturbance by use of the theory of Lyapunov stability. Owing to not all states of ship motion being achieved and only ship course able to be measured on board, a high-gain observer is proposed to estimate the states of ship motion and then an output feedback adaptive robust control algorithm is developed. An example illustrating the method described is included for an ocean going training ship which belongs to our university. It is shown that the controller can make the designed system guarantee the satisfied performance by simulation based on the Matlab Simulink package.

articleTitle: Jigging process human-like intelligent control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Based upon the principle of jigging process, the human-like intelligent control system is built with aim to gain high jig efficiency. The intelligent control system is built in two layers. In the top layer, based on the online evaluating preparing efficiency, the quality and the preparation of raw coal, the intelligent control system can coordinate each sub-control system of the low layer and realize optimal control. In the low layer, a multi-loop fuzzy controllers are built to control the jigging process which is a multi-variable system. The multi-loop fuzzy controllers can satisfactorily control feeder, rejects discharge, middle discharge, downscreen water, and wind system. The application in a coal preparing plant shows that the intelligent control system described in this paper is feasible. The good economic benefit has been gained.

articleTitle: A new type of self-adaptive blind signal separation algorithm based on feed-forward and feedback neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Making use of the self learning ability of neural networks to realize blind signal separation has been proven as an efficient method for signal separation. A different neural network model can produce distinct algorithm efficiency. Based on the feedforward and feedback neural network model, this paper develops a self-adaptive blind source separation algorithm and applies it to signal separation. The performance of the proposed algorithm is illustrated by theoretical analysis and computer simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Cart subsystem to robot soccer based on phase-lock-loop technique
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Robot soccer is a hotspot in AI and Robot fields, and is an integrated system referring to multi fields, such as image processing, communication, automation control and optimize decision, as so on. Based on the brief introduction of the structure to robot soccer system, the cart subsystem is discussed in details. It is used PLL technique to realize precision DC motor timing. With Bluetooth communication technique, the cart subsystem can meet the system demand preferably.

articleTitle: The design of discrete fuzzy slide-mode controller for AC servo system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A new discrete slide-mode controller is designed for an AC servo system according to discrete sliding-mode control theory and fuzzy control theory. The feedforward signal of the command signal is used as an average control, and fuzzy inference is used to regulate the magnitude of on-off control; system chattering is decreased effectively. Simulation study shows that an AC position servo system using this controller can realize tracking of command signals accurately, and has the ability to resist parameter distortion and reject chattering, while exhibiting good control performance.

articleTitle: Quantum motion control in quantum computer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to consider the origin of the decay of the coherence by using analysis of a mathematical model of decoherence in a quantum computer, and then to study control methods to maintain quantum coherence.

articleTitle: A new method for macroeconomic prediction
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Macroeconomics is a complex and nonlinear macrosystem, in which various elements interact with each other. Traditional methods to predict and analyze macroeconomics, such as time series, cannot get satisfactory results. Simply applying artificial neural networks (ANN) also cannot achieve good results. This paper introduces a new method, called Trend Fitting ANN (TFANN), which combines polynomial fit with the traditional ANN method. TFANN disassembles historical economic data to the trending and the fluctuating element, and then analyzes the two elements respectively. The experimental results show the algorithm is reliable and efficient.

articleTitle: Study of calibration and dynamic characteristic of SAFMS-T
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper introduces the theory of six axes force measuring table (SAFMS-T). It will be proved that redundant technology can improve its characteristic, and then a new method of calibration and decoupling should be produced which helps to minimize the high requirement for the rigidity of the material. This also decreases cross-sensitivity errors. Finally the dynamic characteristic and compensation of it should be discussed.

articleTitle: Remote sensing images classification using fuzzy B-spline function neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: We propose a remote sensing image classification algorithm using the membership function adjustable fuzzy B-spline function neural network. In the proposed classification algorithm, the fuzzy technique and neural network technique are combined, and fuzzy inference is realized by a neural network. The B-spline function is used as the membership function of the fuzzy neural network and its shape can be adjusted in real time, which endows the classifier with better capability of learning and self-adaptiveness. Experimental results show that the proposed classification algorithm can be used in remote sensing image classification, and its classification precision is superior to that of the conventional maximum likelihood algorithm.

articleTitle: Improve the resolution of analog digital conversion by software processing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper proposes a method to improve the resolution of analog to digital conversion by software. It is based on the statistical characteristics the AD sampling data and their uncertainty, and suitable to process slowly varied signal with some noise distribution. It provides an idea to select an ADC through eclectic consideration of hardware and software. So the system complexity and cost are lowered. Applications in chromatograph and thermocouple adjuster are introduced.

articleTitle: Chaotic parameter modulation and secure communication
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Based on the adaptive control theory, a controlling strategy of adaptive chaotic synchronization is presented. Simulations show the controlling strategy can synchronize chaos systems under noise, which shows the strategy has a good application in actual communication.

articleTitle: A branch and bound approach for earliness and tardiness penalty problem with distinct due dates
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In this paper, a single machine, n-job scheduling problem, in which each job has a distinct due date-and equal earliness and tardiness coefficients, is studied. The objective is to determine an optimal schedule to minimize the sum of earliness-tardiness penalties. Based on a new theorem for the idle time insertion in the optimal schedule, the paper presents a deterministic algorithm to obtain the upper bound of an optimal schedule. By combining it with an existing lower bound estimation scheme, a fast branch and bound approach for optimal schedule is proposed. Finally, a numerical example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the new method.

articleTitle: Neurofuzzy GMDH network and its application to the soft-sensor for ethene distillation process
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A neurofuzzy GMDH network for system modelling and prediction is developed. This network introduces the structure of GMDH network into its structure and its partial descriptions are represented by the radial functions network which is equivalent to fuzzy models in the first layer and by an N-Adeline network in other layers. The results of function approximation shows that the NF-GMDH network outperforms the conventional GMDH network. The final example shows that NF-GMDH can be used in soft-sensing modelling of the ethene rectification process.

articleTitle: Study of fuzzy controller based on analysis method with PLC
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Fuzzy controller based on analysis method is achieved in this paper. Fuzzification of input signal and fuzzy control rule based on analysis method and defuzzification of output signal are researched, and PLC's ladder is given. The fact shows that this fuzzy controller is inexpensive and practical. It provides wider application for fuzzy control technology.

articleTitle: A simplified constrained multivariable controller with steady-state optimization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A simplified MIMO constrained controller is proposed. Based on the steady-state prediction of system outputs, the controller combines steady-state optimization and dynamic control calculations. A quadratic programming approach is employed to find an optimal feasible solution. The controller is applied to the Shell benchmark problem. Compared with DMC-LP/sup /spl reg// controller, the simulation results show that the new controller not only achieves good control performance, but also costs less in computation time.

articleTitle: Criterion for stable limiting zeros of sampled system with time delay
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Relations between the zeros of a continuous time system and its sampled version is discussed in this note. It depends on the coefficients and the relative degree of the transfer function. The criterion for ensuring limiting stable sampled system with time delay is presented.

articleTitle: A novel data-mining method based on the IMVFEWNN
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Based on analyzing the immune phenomena in nature and utilizing the performance of the existent artificial neural network, a novel network structure, i.e. IMVFEWNN is proposed which integrates the immune mechanism and the structure of neural information processing. The learning algorithm of MVFEWNN is also given which contains the method of selecting an activation function and the adaptive algorithm of the network. This model makes it easy for a user to directly utilize the characteristic information of a pending problem and to simplify the original structure through adjusting the activation function with the prior knowledge, and then the working efficiency and the searching accuracy are both improved. The analysis in theory and the simulating test for the data mining problem show that, compared with the artificial neural network, IMVFEWNN is not only effective but also feasible.

articleTitle: Integral variable structure control of uncertain discrete-time systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In this paper, the control strategy combining an improved discrete-reaching law with equivalent control for uncertain discrete-time systems is present. The system not only has an advantage of strong robustness in variable structure control, but also avoids the chattering phenomenon. Furthermore, by incorporating an integral control, the stable-state precision is enhanced and the system exhibits excellent control characteristics. Simulation results illustrate the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: The research in influences of bodywork attitude's measuring error on the fire control system to calculate the shoot factors
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In the self-propelled weapon, it is analyzed quantitatively that the measuring error of the bodywork's attitude influences the firing control system in calculating the shooting factors. Its content includes two issues: the transform error made by the measuring error of the bodywork's attitude, and its influences on the firing control system to calculate the shooting factors when the coordinates are transformed from the bodywork's reference frame to the level reference frame, and vice versa.

articleTitle: Design of controller for the dual-stage actuator in hard disk drive using internal model approach
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A dual-stage actuator is considered to be the solution to meet the challenges of ever-increasing track density in hard disk drives. The low-inertia secondary actuator of the dual-stage actuator makes it possible to reposition the read/write head quickly to follow the sharp variations in the track. This allows better control of the tracking error during track-following mode of the servo system. Unfortunately, the physical characteristics of the secondary actuators vary widely due to imperfections in the manufacturing process and the variation in the material properties. Robustness is, therefore, a very important factor in the design of the servo controller. Internal model control (IMC) is regarded as a tool for designing a robust controller. We present the results of the design of servo controller for a dual-stage actuator using this internal model approach. Effectiveness of the controller is verified through simulation.

articleTitle: The research of synergetic algorithm in intelligent control of crystal growth
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper discusses the problem of multilevel control in an intelligent control system, and presents an intelligent control system of crystal growth. The synergetic algorithm in system identification is proposed.

articleTitle: Research and analysis of multi-dimensional association rules mining
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper proposes two data cube based multi-dimensional association rules mining algorithms which integrate the classical association rules mining algorithm with data cube technology and presents the differences in mining efficiency between two algorithm.

articleTitle: Research of control system in fusion architectures
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Human fusion offers important principles for the design of machine fusion. The most important is the separability of control, estimation and abstraction,without which competent real-time responsiveness cannot be assured. Another is to separate intention from embodiment, so that intentions can be flexibly embodied. Yet another, similar to human emotions,is the use of positive feedback events and subsequent feed-forward to produce timely responses to dynamic situations. Still another, leveraging the trajectory of human cognitive development,is to control scope of processing by layering data abstractions, both to husband bandwidth and so that processing results can be immediately apprehended by human users. Using these principles, machine fusion can increase both its competence and also users' perception of its competence, increasing the likelihood that the machine will be received and treated as a trusted partner.

articleTitle: A representing model of rule distribution in temporal sequence
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In recent years, there has been a lot of interest in using data mining techniques to extract rules from temporal sequences in various applications. Previous works on rule discovery mainly considered global pattern behaviors. In this paper, we consider the rules of which the frequency is large only in a subsequence of the original sequence. To facilitate the discovery of rule distribution, we present a representing model, which is to segment the sequence into a set of continuous subsequence, in which there exists a rule set that appears frequently. We present the definition of local rule and our model, together with the relating methods. We analyze the behavior of the problem and our algorithms with both synthetic and real data. The results obtained correspond with the definition of our problem and reveal a kind of novel knowledge.

articleTitle: Research and development of integrated intelligent control system of coking stove combustion
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: According to the characteristics and control demand of coking stove combustion, based on fuzzy evolutionary neural network theory, combined with technology of fuzzy control and expert control, intelligent predictive model based integrated intelligent control system structure and an algorithm with self-learning and long-delay-solving for the coking stove is put forward. It has been applied to the temperature control of the actual coking stove and has achieved good control results.

articleTitle: A model reference adaptive control algorithm for fuzzy dynamic systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper presents an approach to adaptive control for a class of fuzzy dynamic models. The adaptive control law is first designed in each local region and then constructed in global domain. It is shown that the resulting fuzzy adaptive control system is globally stable. Robustness issues of the adaptive control system are also addressed.

articleTitle: Learning algorithm for discourse of universe adaptive fuzzy controller
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A new adaptive discourse of universe idea is brought forward in the thesis based on the interpolator mechanism of fuzzy controller in order to enhance the steady precision of control systems. The idea is that the discourse of universe of fuzzy controller reduces with the inputs decrease only when the control system approaches the steady state, the control rules are not changed at the same time. And the idea has been proved to be reasonable by theoretical analysis. Furthermore, an adaptive discourse of universe strategy is put forward. The method is tested to be effective by the control system simulation of steam pressure of boiler.

articleTitle: On the robustness of linear delayed systems with nonlinear uncertain parameters
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The present paper studies the robust stability of an uncertain state-space system with time delay. The uncertain state-space time-delayed model which allows second-order uncertain parameters, and the time-delayed model has a strong practical background. A robustness criteria based on the model is derived.

articleTitle: A new state feedback control design approach which guarantees the critical realization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: State feedback control (SF, defined as a constant gain K on the plant system state x) is by far the best form of control. However the existing design of K always assumes x is fully available. Thus this design ignores the realization of SF control when x is unmeasurable. Hence for most plants, the critical loop transfer function and robustness properties of SF control cannot be realized. This paper presents a simple, complete and systematic design approach whose design of K is bayed on the parameters of the realizing observer and does not assume x is fully available, and which can realize the loop transfer function and robustness properties of its SF control for most plants. This new SF control unifies completely the existing SF control and static output feedback control, and it can still achieve high feedback system performance and robustness for most plants.

articleTitle: Delay-dependent conditions for block energy decoupling of linear systems with time-varying delays
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper presents an input-output block energy decoupling method for linear systems with time-varying delays. It is an approximate decoupling approach, under which the energy of each block input controls mainly the energy of a corresponding block output and influences the energy of the other block outputs as weakly as possible. The results depend on the size of delay and are given in terms of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). With the powerful LMI toolbox, it is very convenient to solve this problem.

articleTitle: Hamilton-Jacobi inequality based reliable H/sup /spl infin// control for nonlinear systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In this paper, the problem of reliable H/sup /spl infin// control for affine systems is addressed. First, the normal state, partial failure and outage of an actuator are simultaneously considered by introducing a new actuator model, then, two reliable H/sup /spl infin// controllers are proposed for two cases: one has only one faulty actuator in the set of all actuators, and the other has a certain number of faulty actuators in a pre-specified subset of all the actuators. The conditions for the existence of reliable H/sup /spl infin// controllers are presented. The analyses show that the resulting closed-loop control system is asymptotically stable and has certain disturbance attenuation ability.

articleTitle: Study and development on detecting device of wire rope localized fault
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The wire rope is widely used in harbors, ships, and many industrial fields. The safety of wire rope closely relates to the life safety and equipment safety. Therefore, the fault detection of wire rope is always study focus in the NDT area. The paper presents a new instrument for localized fault detection of wire rope. By the special structure of detecting transducer, the interfere signal from the leakage field of rope twist can be filter efficiently. After dimension contraction and characteristic value extraction of multi-ways signals, the quantitative Fuzzy recognition for localized faults of wire rope is realized. The testing result shows, the new instrument works better in detecting the localized faults of wire rope.

articleTitle: The lining-cutting robot system's control technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The paper introduces the control architecture and control methods of a novel lining and cutting system: the Lining-Cutting Robot System. The system adopts modular design, and it can be decomposed in to six modules: the main control computer, the measuring system, the robot system, the lining system, the cutting system, and other assistant equipment. The system takes full advantage of the computer interfaces' functions, which make the huge system's hierarchy clear and make the system easy to design. The success of the system has important reference value for the design of industry robot system.

articleTitle: A novel fast algorithm for blind signal separation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The independent component analysis (ICA) for blind source separation is investigated in this paper. A contrast function is given based on maximum likelihood and mutual information theory. A fast iterative ICA algorithm is derived by optimizing the function. The method does not need to calculate the higher order statistics of signals, and has the property of second-order convergence. The experimental results for separation of simulation and real signals using the proposed algorithm is presented.

articleTitle: On the choice of overall transfer functions
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The linear algebra method for designing rational control systems consists of two steps: Selecting an overall transfer function and then designing the controller. Once an overall transfer function is chosen, the rest of the design is straightforward. This paper will discuss how to select a suitable overall transfer function for linear plant with time delay. The problem can be formulated as: Given a linear proper plant with time delay, search an overall transfer function such that the overall system is internally stable and has some other desired properties. Sufficient and necessary conditions are given and constructing procedure is developed. Numerical examples are provided to illustrated the proposed method.

articleTitle: Mining frequent sub-trends in time-series databases
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Mining time-series databases is a novel and important problem in the field of data mining. Most previous work focused on the similarity of the naive time series. Some authors proposed the similarity of trends rather than time series. Based on the approach presented in this paper, more formal definitions of trends for process data are given. The problem of mining frequent sub-trends in a long trend sequence is formulated and an algorithm to solve this problem is developed. Experiments were done on a simplified simulation system, which showed that the satisfying results were achieved.

articleTitle: A novel tracking gate algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A novel gate algorithm for tracking target in a heavy clutter environment is presented in this paper. The main features of this method are: 1) to set up a performance function of data association based on some prior-probabilities; and 2) to estimate the gate size by searching the optimal solution of this performance function. Finally, this gate method was compared with some of the classical methods.

articleTitle: The research of fault-detection measure in the redundant system with inertial measurement unit on the satellite
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper presents a study of fault-detection measurement in redundant systems with an inertial measurement unit on the satellite. In order to deal with system noise, we use a Kalman filter and we employ backpropagation neural networks for fault detection. The simulation results of our measurement compare favourably with those of the SPRT and direct-compare approaches.

articleTitle: A kind of ordering method with the permission of backorder in MRP
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The decision characteristics on lot-sizing in MRP systems include: multiple time periods, finite time horizons, discrete demands, etc. According to these characteristics, we present a model of linear programming and the optimal lot-sizing problem can then be calculated by using a general-purpose linear program solver, like EXCEL, UNDO, etc.

articleTitle: Study on condition monitoring and diagnosis system of hydroelectric generating set
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The hydroelectric generating set is suffered from the joint shock of water flow, machinery and electricity, its condition monitoring and diagnosis is complicated. Besides carefully to set suitable condition parameter measurement points, the diagnostic model is another key problem. In additional, how to link with the SCADA and MIS of hydropower station for the condition monitoring and diagnosis system must be elaborately considered. This paper briefly introduces the hardware structure, software design, and the diagnostic model study of condition monitoring and diagnosis system for a hydropower station. Parts of research achievements have been applied to the real machine successfully.

articleTitle: Output feedback stabilization for a class of complex systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In this paper we consider the problem of output feedback stabilization for a class of interconnect linear systems, which does not need to decompose the uncertainty terms in the systems with the numerical value bound; and at the same time, the uncertainty terms do not need to satisfy the matching conditions. A simple controller was constructed to demonstrate the ease of use in practice.

articleTitle: Design of optical-electrical encoder pulse counting card based on PC-bus
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In this paper, we first introduce the basic working principle of optical-electrical encoder that is a kind of digital displacement sensor. Then we present guidelines for designing optical-electrical encoder pulse counting card based on PC-bus, including such aspects as counting mode, pulse signal shaping and antijamming, data latching, I/O address allocating, read/write register format, timer and interrupt, etc. Finally we present an approach to design the driving program.

articleTitle: Study on the excitation strategy for eliminating negative-dumping [for dumping read damping]
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper analyzes the reason for low-frequency oscillation based on characteristic dynamic equation of synchronous machine. It is reasonable that a supplementary signal to the voltage regulator can increase damping by sensing vertical axis current of synchronous machine. Excitation strategy of eliminating negative dumping was put forward and the structure of regulator was designed. The regulation method was capable of improving stability of power system and adapting to the variety of system. Therefore, a novel approach was explored in the field of excitation.

articleTitle: A new algorithm of fuzzy neural networks with multiple form fuzzy weights
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A fuzzy neural network (FNN) architecture with fuzzy weight is proposed. The cost function depending on the fuzzy input and level sets of the fuzzy targets are defined, which can educe a learning algorithm that will be used to adjust the parameters which denote the fuzzy weight. The principles of the algorithm so that it can be applicable to the fuzzy weight with multiple forms are generalized. Then the algorithm is proved to be available by simulation studies.

articleTitle: Reheated temperature adaptive fuzzy control system of unit
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to solve the control problem on the reheated temperature of unit which has such characteristics of time-varying, time delay and multi-disturbance, etc. The traditional control and general fuzzy control are difficult to dispose these matters that the model is time-varying, and the fuzzy rule number increases sharply with the increasing systemic variable number, so that the expression of the systemic knowledge becomes complex drastically. Accordingly, a new adaptive fuzzy control is proposed, which has a layered structure and makes use of the quasi-damping rate, oscillation degree, residual error and overshoot, and forms the monitor control rule set. It was applied to the reheated temperature system of the peak load modulation power unit. The simulation indicates that this method has preferable dynamic and static characteristics, and stronger robustness.

articleTitle: Fuzzy normal proposition logic systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A new logical structure, the fuzzy normal proposition logic, is defined in this paper. For describing objective items, it is quite near to their original appearances, and may well be realized in popular computers. We discuss some of the properties of the logical structure, and establish a fuzzy normal proposition probability space.

articleTitle: Design of a new controller based on D-S evidential theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The single-input and single-output loop controller using only one sensor is widely applied in the industrial control field. As it is difficult to obtain the precise response of the control using only one sensor, the result cannot satisfy the demand. In the multi-sensors system, one must solve the problem of fusing different uncertainty data. This paper discusses a new design method for the controller in the light of Dempster-Shafer (D-S) evidential theory, and presents an algorithm to define the basic probability assignment by using fuzzy control. Finally, the new controller was applied to the chemical dosage control system in the water treatment industry.

articleTitle: Characteristics and application of a DCS
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The characteristics and configuration of a distributed control system: SUPCON JX-300DCS, are introduced. The application of this system to the solution of complete circling urea production, including technological process and design of DCS control scheme is presented.

articleTitle: Self-tuning predictor and its application in electric power systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Based on the self-tuning theory, a new self-tuning recursive predictor is proposed for nonstationary time series. Very good results were obtained by using the predictor for the prediction of electric power systems.

articleTitle: Study on kinematic modeling of shipborne crane under ship's movement
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: For the inchoate study on the carrier crane, the characteristics of it are not well known. Especially, its characteristics when the ship is rolling have not been studied yet. Using the modeling methods of usual manipulators and based on the kinematics in a non-inertial frame, this paper builds a kinematic model of the carrier crane, which not only can describe the influence of the ship's yaw but also give the movements with big angles of the crane's end-wire rope-loads. The model provides the essential mathematic model for the kinematic study of the carrier crane. What's more, a group of simulation curves is been put up with, which improve the effective of the modeling method and the correct of the model.

articleTitle: Study and application of a class of neural networks model with better generalization ability
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper studies the factors that affect the generalization ability of a neural network model. Take an example of alumina concentration soft sensing in the process of aluminum electrolysis, some measures are presented to improve the model's generalization ability. They include constructing neural networks with prior knowledge, ensuring the quantity and quality of samples through the special experiments and training neural networks both off-line and on-line. The practical application shows their effectiveness. The neural network model based on these design methods proved to be precise. It has better generalization ability and provides a reliable guarantee for advanced process control.

articleTitle: Simulation study on coordinated PID neural network control for boiler-turbine unit
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A boiler-turbine unit is a complex multivariable system with strong time-variation, uncertainty and coupling. The improvement of its control quality is a key problem for automation improvement in thermal engineering. The PID neural network is a feedforward multiplayer network with a simplified and normalized structure and good static and dynamic properties. Based on the modification of its learning algorithm, a coordinated control system for the boiler-turbine unit has been designed. Simulation results verify the satisfactory decoupling-control property and robustness.

articleTitle: Analytical formulas for the new two degree-of-freedom Smith predictor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper shows how to apply the optimal design method to the design of the new two degree-of-freedom Smith predictor for stable processes with time delay. The optimal performance criteria for tracking of a reference setpoint and disturbance rejection are presented respectively. Systematic and general design procedure is then developed. By approximating a system of infinite dimensions with systems of finite dimensions, the controllers are derived analytically. It is found that the results of Zhang et al. (1998) can be directly derived by the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of sampled-data controller based on approximation of nonlinear systems: asymptotical stabilization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A sufficient condition is presented for the asymptotical stabilization of the nonlinear control systems with the designed controller based on its approximate discrete-time models for a suitable fixed sampling period. By means of the notion of continuous prototype of nonlinear discrete-time systems we are able to discuss the asymptotical stabilization of sampled-data systems in the framework of continuous time.

articleTitle: Research of the service chain management in manufacture enterprises
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The collaboration of enterprises to gain the maximum profit is the trend of the modern enterprise. In today's economy the competition is shifting from individual company performance to supply chain performance. In the customers-orient market strategy, service is not only the last phase of a product life, but also exists through out the whole life cycle. The service for the supply chain's end-customer is not only the duty of the last chain enterprise, but is also the whole supply chain business. The supply chain consists of a service chain to serve the customers. This paper discusses the form and main content of a service chain and an integration scheme of the service chain management platform. Finally, some of the problems needed to be solved in the subsequent research are outlined.

articleTitle: Dynamic production scheduling system based on data warehouse
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In today's manufacturing systems, the production-scheduling system in shops usually is a weak partition. The paper proposes an architecture of dynamic scheduling and presents the implementation structure of the dynamic production scheduling system based on data warehouse and knowledge discover in database. Then, the key technologies used in this system are discussed. The paper presents a new method of developing a scheduling system.

articleTitle: Controller optimisation of a tube heat exchanger
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This study seeks to improve the process control of an ammonia/steam heat exchanger by optimising the existing PID controllers. The exit ammonia temperature of the heat exchanger is maintained by the combination of three PID controllers, an ammonia temperature controller, a pressure controller and a steam pressure controller. Originally, the pressure and temperature controllers were de-tuned to prevent interaction, which results in below optimal control. Due to the hazardous materials and operating conditions, we first develop the mathematical models for the heat exchanger and steam. Then simulations are carried out to develop control schemes. Finally a suitable optimisation schemes that could be applied to the existing control hardware, a 'feed forward' with 'dynamic decoupling' strategy was proposed. The control scheme was then programmed into the DCS and plant trials performed to fine tune the control schemes. The system now does not require any operator intervention after starting as it quickly reaches and maintains setpoint without any nuisance alarms.

articleTitle: Application of neural network approach for MAP-MRF model-based MEG source imaging
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Magnetoencephalography (MEG) source image reconstruction is an important and difficult problem in image processing applications. It can be formulated as an inherent ill-posed and highly underdetermined linear inverse problem, encompassing a great variety of signal modeling and processing methods.
