According to anatomical and physiological knowledge, source distributed image is modeled by a Markov random field (MRF), and the reconstruction is defined as the maximum a posteriori estimate (MAP) based on a Bayesian framework. To acquire a global minimum solution from the posterior energy function, many optimization methods (such as GA, SA, MFA, etc.) appear in the literature are investigated. In this paper, we incorporate the ideas of artificial neural networks into this difficult optimization task. Several computer experiments were conducted in order to assess the performance of the introduced technique.

articleTitle: Structure and stabilization of neutral large scale interconnected control systems with multi-delays
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Some new concepts of the structure are established for multi-group multi-delays neutral large scale control systems. A positive definite quadratic form V-function via choosing the symmetric positive definite solution matrix of the Riccati matrix differential equation is made up. On the basis of the equivalence method of Lyapunov's function, a sufficient criteria is obtained for the interconnected stabilization of the control system without delays and perturbation parameters imply the interconnected stabilization of the multi-group multi-delays and perturbation parameters neutral large scale control system. At the same time, some estimation formulae of the bounds for both time-delays and perturbation parameters are given.

articleTitle: The intelligence integral fuzzy controller
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper improves the steady capability of a basic fuzzy controller by additive intelligence integral, and thus obtain a better result of the control.

articleTitle: Selecting secondary measurements for soft sensor modeling using rough sets theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper introduces the rough sets theory for secondary measurement selection of soft sensor modeling. Using the rough sets theory, a smaller set of secondary measurements containing the most information of the primary variable can be found. This method has been implemented at Shanghai Refinery for the soft sensor to estimate the propylene composition, and a good result is obtained.

articleTitle: Learning in coach-based distributed multi-agent system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The distributed multi-agent system (DMAS) is a significant research topic in artificial intelligence, the crossing of distributed multi-agent intelligence and machine learning is focused on by many researchers. The paper introduces some learning methods in DMAS and puts forward that an agent can improve the ability of predicting other agents' actions.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of networks of finite terminals with general distribution of service time
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In this paper an approximate mathematical model is obtained for a queue systems of networks with finite terminal stations and the arrival process to each station to be Poisson and the service time for each data packet to be random with general distributions. By using the state transformation property of imbedded Markov chain, the algorithm and performance analysis for the average delay of the packets in the system, the mean utilization of the server, the mean utilization of each terminal station, and the average throughput by a node are given.

articleTitle: Robust controller design for the uncertain system with time-delay
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: We discuss the robust controller design problem for a class of uncertain system with time-delay. The linear state feedback controller is designed for the case that the perturbations satisfy nonlinear uncertainty, by applying the Lyapunov function method and the technique of matrix inequality, and the controller obtained only depends on the solution of a matrix Lyapunov equation. A numerical example is given.

articleTitle: Research on improving performance of networked control system based on IA method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The paper introduced advantage, disadvantage and the status of industrial control application in DCS, FCS and Ethernet, and bring out a method, based on the idea of working in coordination of intelligent agents in the field of distributed artificial intelligence, by which the security and reliability of networked control system can be improved.

articleTitle: Design and application of fuzzy controller with PI regulator in position control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A designing strategy of a fuzzy controller with PI regulator, which has been successfully applied to a C200H PLC-based automatic position control system for an aluminum plate roughing mill, is presented. The theoretical analysis of the PI regulator and the simulation study of the fuzzy controller are respectively put forward. The software and hardware structures, the configuration of the PLC, and the practical operation results are also described. The features of the system are quick dynamic response, low cost, high reliability, and simple and flexible operation. The positioning accuracy of the system is within 0.02 mm.

articleTitle: Fuzzy simulation based on genetic algorithm and its application
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper firstly analyses the disadvantages of several optimization tactics used in engineering system design, then mainly introduces a novel optimization algorithm, i.e., fuzzy simulation based on genetic algorithm, aiming at the shortcoming of conventional fuzzy simulation such as hypo-optimal solutions. The algorithm presented in this paper can obtain satisfying results by means of GA's advantage. And through the simulation results this algorithm turns out high efficiency.

articleTitle: Study on bandwidth allocation optimization of FF acyclic communication
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In process control application of FF, in order to ensure that acyclic communication with critical time constraints is met, the bandwidth proportion allocated to acyclic communication is oversized, which lead to waste of bandwidth. For the sake of improving bandwidth availability of FF, in this paper, based on priority mechanism, bandwidth allocation of FF is analyzed, and two bandwidth allocation strategies are researched and compared in performance. Finally, optimization strategy of FF acyclic communication is proposed based on generalization of preceding results.

articleTitle: A performance recovery to robust H/sub /spl infin// control for robot based on high-gain observer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The dynamic performance of the robot is always affected by the parameter uncertainties and unknown disturbance. When the joint positions and velocities of the robot can be measured, the unknown disturbance can be attenuated and the exponential stability can be guaranteed by the state feedback under some conditions. If the joint positions can be measured, but the velocities can't be measured, the dynamic performance of the close-loop system can be recovered by the high-gain observer.

articleTitle: PID-parameter auto-tuner based on embedded MCU
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper describes an algorithm of PID-parameter tuning with correlation-coefficient identification, which is applied in the auto-tuner of PID-parameters based on an embedded MCU. We have optimized the algorithm according to the features of the MCU.

articleTitle: Optimal point-wise control of distributed parameter systems based on wavelet transform
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Point-wise control is a typical control strategy for distributed parameter systems control. Since the employment of /spl delta/-function in point-wise control, it becomes very difficult to design the control law. The orthogonal function approximation is applied to deal with the optimal point-wise control of distributed parameter systems, and Haar wavelets have been chosen as orthogonal functions in this paper. The differential operational matrix and the product integrated operational matrix of Haar wavelet base have been proposed. The various operational matrices have been applied to convert the optimal point-wise control of distributed parameter systems to the lumped one, and an approximation algorithm has been obtained. The illustrated simulation results have validated the efficiency of the presented algorithm.

articleTitle: Transmitting power control based on control system framework in CDMA system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Surveys the research in transmitting power control (TPC) in CDMA cellular systems with an emphasis on the aspects of power controller design. First of all, some basic theories of power control are reviewed from the point of view of communication. Then the TPC problem is put in the standard framework of a control process, and quantities in TPC are treated as control system components. Most of the available control strategies are then reviewed, and the focus is put on the step size design of the power controller. Finally future research directions for TPC are suggested.

articleTitle: Nonlinear separation control with neural learning for evaporator in energy conversion plant
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Nonlinear separation control with neural learning for complex nonlinear system was proposed. This method combined a nonlinear separation method with an artificial neural network. With learning from actual data, it can not only realize nonlinear control of complex nonlinear systems, but also improve the control performance. Based on this method, outlet working fluid heat rate control of an evaporator in a spring thermal energy conversion plant, as a typical application of the proposed method, was realized. The simulation results verified the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of airport workflow control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: An automatic workflow control system of airport is analyzed, the principle of the system is introduced, and the design of the control system is expounded.

articleTitle: Research on engineering change management in virtual enterprise
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The virtual enterprise (VE) is a new type of enterprise organization. It needs cooperative work supported by a computer network, where some new characteristics and new problems that are different from traditional manufacturing models emerge. The engineering change in a VE is distributed and often needs parallel treatment. To control change effectively and treat it in parallel, a method that uses a change propagation graph to analyze change implementation, and a change process model based on a Petri net were presented in the paper.

articleTitle: New recursive algorithm on model orders and its application
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In this paper, a new multi-dimensional recursive algorithm is given for multi-input, multi-output ARMAX systems. Satisfactory results can all be obtained in many simulation experiments.

articleTitle: A study on the situation-oriented selection methods of uncertain participation decision-making
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Illustrates the basic principles of the method of uncertain participation decision making and analyzes its systematic requirements and basis, constructs its logical framework and gives the solution of recognizing participation decision making and analyzing administration participation decision and its features. The UPDM method solves the participation decision making problems of two aspects: one is to provide the logical approaches of solving participation decision making problems under certain conditions; the other is to provide a mode of government participation decision-making generally deciding through the problem analysis on the basis of uncertain systematic collective information, which comprehensively analyzes the problems under uncertain conditions. The UPDM method not only applies to the certain recognizable system, but also the complicated uncertain system, which ensures its own systematic integration and feasibility of solving problems.

articleTitle: Management of the limited dynamic processes on the basis of variation on auxiliary integrated surfaces
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Approaches of robust control systems synthesis, both linear and nonlinear and non-stationary is offered. The control is carried out, providing the given phase constraints vary in acceptable limits, in view of constraints on its value and incompleteness of the information about functioning disturbances. The approach is based on introduction of auxiliary integral surfaces, on which the initial moving is projected. As a result the reduced equivalent moving is formed, described by a scalar equation, which in many important cases can be integrated directly. On the basis of the obtained equation solving of a synthesis task is carried out and can be reduced to algebraic or integral inequalities. The final relations defined for linear equivalent moving are presented.

articleTitle: Robust two-degree-of-freedom internal model control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A robust two-degree-of-freedom internal model control scheme for typical industrial process is proposed to improve the performance of the conventional internal model controller. It contains two controllers that can be separately designed. Very good dynamic response performance of both the command tracking and disturbance rejection characteristics and robustness can be achieved simultaneously. Simulation results show the validity of the proposed control scheme and the correctness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: NN adaptive control of spacecraft attitude
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Modern spacecraft demand an attitude control system with very high performance and accuracy, and many new features, such as self-modification, adaptability, more autonomy and fault tolerance. NN adaptive control can be applied to spacecraft attitude control to meet the demanding requirements and to provide many new features. To control spacecraft attitude motion, a recurrent NN is used to train as an identification model and an adaptive controller. The quaternion method can overcome the singularity problem in a traditional Euler differential equation. To accelerate the convergence speed of the NN training course, an extended Kalman filter method is used to train NN weights.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent architecture of real-time dispatching automation for power systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: First of all, this article described current problems on electric power automation system, raised the concept of intelligent power dispatching architecture (IPDA) and its corresponding intelligence meaning, it is an extension to the research field for the "intelligence" among artificial intelligence. The problems mentioned on this article can be solved through systematic research of IPDA. The real time dispatching intelligent power automation system architecture has been designed, and the meaning of intelligence corresponding to the different level of the architecture has been analyzed based on IEC61xxx series industry standard and the MAS theories on artificial intelligence. Part of concepts has been utilized in reality.

articleTitle: Guaranteed-cost design based on T-S fuzzy model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Using a guaranteed cost control approach, the problem of Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy controller design via Linear Matrix Inequalities (LMIS) is presented in this paper. The feedback control law is obtained through solving LMIS. This method not only has guaranteed stability, but also minimizes an upper bound on a linear quadratic performance measure. The example for a fuzzy controller of the inverted pendulum demonstrates the effectiveness of this approach.

articleTitle: Application of dynamic programming theory to the alignment of SINS
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)

articleTitle: Multiple-objective optimization decision-making method for large scale systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In this paper, the global optimization problem for separable non-convex large-scale systems is considered. A three-level hierarchical optimization algorithm is proposed. It converts the original problem into a separable multi-objective optimization problem. The non-inferior frontier is then convexified and the global optimal solution of the original problem is selected from the set of non-inferior solutions of the multi-objective optimization problem. The theoretical basis of the algorithm is established. Simulation shows that the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Robust nonlinear control for bank-to-turn missile
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Based on the two-timescale assumption, the dynamics of the Bank-to-Turn (BTT) missile are firstly separated into two parts: the dynamics of fast states and the dynamics of slow states. The velocities of BTT missile are chosen as state variables of the slow dynamics. The aerodynamic force coefficients are not linearized. First, the dynamics of fast states and the dynamics of slow states are linearized by using feedback linearization theory, then, considering the uncertainty of the aerodynamic coefficients of the BTT missile, the desired dynamics of fast states and the dynamics of slow states are designed based on Lyapunov stability theory. Six degree of freedom simulation results have shown the rightness and effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: The big capacity boiler superheated steam temperature fuzzy-smith control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Because the boiler steam temperature control has strong dynamic delay and inertia and time-varying nonlinear property, the control plan of combining the guidance differential double loop with fuzzy-smith expected compensation is used. Simulation results show that the control system has better performance and stronger adaptive capability than the conventional control plan. It can raise its robustness and has a small capacity for counting. The time suitability of the control system can meet the demands of the operating process.

articleTitle: Neural networks based optimum coagulation dosing rate control applied to water purification system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: By the analysis of coagulant dosing rate and its influencing factors, the neural network predicting theory was introduced into the water treatment technology creatively and a predicting model of coagulant dosing rate was established. The test results obtained indicate that this model is adaptive and its self-learning ability is effective. The prediction results' accuracy can be markedly improved by the neural network's online self-learning. The online predictive control of coagulant dosing rates can be achieved by using this model, and presents an effective way for the realization of optimal coagulant dosing rates.

articleTitle: H/sub /spl infin// robust control of electrohydraulic shaking table in the centrifugal force field
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In this paper, the theoretical mathematical model of the electrohydraulic shaking table in the centrifugal force field is established, and the H/sub /spl infin// robust control rule is adopted. The result of simulation shows that this control method is very useful for a system that has some uncertainty and large amounts of noise.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of ant system optimization processes
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In the paper, the ant system (AS) optimization algorithm in continuous space is used for examples of optimum value searching of continuous function. In the paper, the general evaluation parameters are defined. It considers the general optimization dynamics of the whole ant system. Two evaluation functions are defined. The paper discusses the performance evaluation of the defined AS algorithm in continuous space.

articleTitle: Time division multiple access based on CAN
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Real-time property is becoming an enabling technology for many important distributed applications. In this paper, related topic towards the design of distributed real-time control systems based on CAN have been presented. Through a simple systematic model, TDMA based on CAN has been realized to meet the demands of system real-time property.

articleTitle: Self-tuning of controller using neural network and genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper presents a scheme of self-tuning of controllers. The proposed scheme employs neural networks to map the nonlinear relationships between parameters of controller and performance specifications of step response. Genetic algorithm is used to optimize these parameters. Self-tuning of fuzzy logic controller shows the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: A non-linear prediction speech coding system based on ANN
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A non-linear prediction speech coding system based on an ANN is introduced. In this coding system, the bit rate is not increased by the backward predictor. The pure backpropagation (BP) algorithm is replaced by the improved difference BP algorithm. The experimental results have indicated: the predictor based on an ANN has high prediction gain and the speech dependencies can been extracted by it though the embedding dimension is low. The speed quality of the new system is better than that of the speech coding standard G.721 system.

articleTitle: An multiobjective optimization method based on grey evaluation and genetic algorithms
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Solving multiobjective optimization problems in many real-world domains is complicated because of insufficient data, multi-objection and multi-measurement, etc. In this paper, a multiobjective grey optimization model is suggested to describe the situation and a new method, based on the grey relational clustering analysis and genetic algorithms, is proposed to deal with the model. The simulation results demonstrate that the model is suitable and the method is effective.

articleTitle: Neural network control with fuzzy predictor for ship autopilots
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A neural network control scheme with fuzzy predictor for ship autopilots is proposed. Parameters of a fuzzy predictor are optimized by using a genetic algorithm. The BP (backpropagation) learning algorithm is used for neural network control. The simulation result has shown that the proposed control scheme is effective.

articleTitle: Research on an adaptive directional mutation genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Based on the theory of simulated annealing, this paper presents an adaptive directional mutation strategy that adjusts the mutation step using the gradual information of the fitness function at the search point. This strategy makes the mutated individual approaching the local optimization and greatly improves the evolution speed and at the same time weakens the convergence possibility. Simulation results confirm that this algorithm not only takes on strong overall search ability but also improves the convergence speed greatly.

articleTitle: Study on a knowledge based expert system for diagnosing casting defects
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A knowledge based expert system for diagnosing casting defects is developed by using artificial intelligence technology. The knowledge base of the system is formed by the production rules. The uncertain problem of knowledge is solved using the forward-backward inference control strategy and certainty theory. The defect diagnosis of casting is realized according to the human expert's mode of thinking. The knowledge representation, inference technology and composition of the system are mainly discussed in the paper.

articleTitle: PID self-tuning control based on evolutionary programming
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: With the difficult in controlling dead-time and nonlinear system, a new method of fuzzy parameter self-tuning PID control which is based on the combination of evolutionary programming and fuzzy theory is proposed in this paper, it uses evolutionary programming directly to derive fuzzy rule bases of PID parameter tuning. To a certain extent, it overcomes the shortcoming of single fuzzy control and conventional PID. The simulation result of Dead-time and nonlinear systems shows better static and dynamic performance of the new approach than that of conventional PID control.

articleTitle: The technique for measurement path be controlled based on surface reverse and ultrasonic measurement
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Based on robust techniques and ultrasonic measurement techniques, a technique of controlling the measurement path is proposed when curved surface workpieces were tested by ultrasonic measurement. Then, an initial curved surface model of the workpieces was constructed, which had no design file. Finally, by resolving the kinetic point position of the ultrasonic probe in the measurement path, robust checking and measurement path which can be controlled are achieved.

articleTitle: A three-dimensional cellular automaton designed for simulating tumor growth
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper constructs a tumor growth model (TGM) based on three-dimensional cellular automaton. The cells of the TGM are divided into normal cells and abnormal cells by their state values. The abnormal cells mean tumor cells and divided into proliferative cells, nonproliferative cells and necrotic cells by their state values. The TGM unifies the evolution rules of the normal cells and abnormal cells including proliferative and nonproliferative cells and necrotic cells. The cells and its neighborhoods and evolution rules of the TGM completely abide by the design principle of standard cellular automata so that virtual experiment and analysis on the TGM can be carried out with the unified theoretical frame of cellular automata.

articleTitle: Optimal motion planning for mobile robot based on potential fields
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The paper addresses motion planning for a mobile robot in a dynamic environment with multiple moving obstacles. A motion planning strategy based on potential field and optimal control theory is presented for mobile robots to solve the problem of navigation and obstacles avoidance. Simulation results are presented to show fine real-time property, avoid the obstacles effectively and almost arrive at the goal on time.

articleTitle: Adaptive fuzzy predictive tracking of feed supporting system for the square kilometre array
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In view of the characteristics of time-varying and large delay constant of cable-feed supporting system for next generation large radio telescope-Square Kilometer Array (SKA), the decentralized control strategy and an adaptive fuzzy predictive controller (AFPC) are proposed to realize the feed coarse tracking. The AFPC consists of a fuzzy predictor and a fuzzy predictive controller, and the on-line correction of which is carried out using BP algorithm. The simulation results have shown that the tracking precision is much favorable to guarantee the coarse tracking precision requirement, which have laid a solid base for the engineering implementation of the high precision requirement of the feed tracking control for the SKA.

articleTitle: Fuzzy expert system for fault diagnosis of robotic assembly
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Based on the working flow of an automated robotic assembly line, a fuzzy expert system (FES) for fault diagnosis of the assembly line is developed, which contains a user interface, knowledge base, inference engine and history database. The FES adopts a fuzzy forward chaining rule-based reference strategy and can predict the severity of faults according to a certainty factor. In addition, fuzzy logic and linguistic terms are also introduced.

articleTitle: Fuzzy-prediction control for overflow density in milling-classifier operation system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A fuzzy-prediction controller is used to control the overflow density of a milling-classifier operation system, which has uncertainty factors and nonlinear time-delay characteristics which introduces difficulties for mathematical modeling. By applying fuzzy control to stabilize the system, then a new predictive model based on the controlled parameter is developed. However, fuzzy-prediction control gets a satisfactory control result for overflow density. Practical production has proved that the ore feeding of the ball mill improved 6.0%, reclaiming rate added 2.0% and the average stable state error of overflow density was less than 3.0%, and made remarkable economic profit.

articleTitle: An algorithm of characteristic expansion for fuzzy reasoning based on triple I method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In accordance with the problem of fuzzy reasoning in the longer reasoning chaining of expert systems, the fuzzy reasoning algorithm of characteristic expansion based on the triple I method was proposed. The fuzzy reasoning model, a new set of algorithms applied to imprecise spreading in expert systems, was deduced. Besides, this model just accorded with the general model of imprecise reasoning of expert systems in an abstract framework and was widely available. The barrier of fuzzy reasoning in expert systems was broken down theoretically.

articleTitle: Control by non-stationary driving of the hopping apparatus
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The problem of hierarchical control by nonstationary driving of the hopping apparatus is considered. It is shown that as well as in the case of a walking apparatus, the problem can be reduced to construction of the periodic solution of the discrete Riccati equation. The outcomes of simulation testify the efficiency of the offered algorithm.

articleTitle: Applying of virtual reality in MATLAB
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: MATLAB is a mathematics software applied broad in high-powered numerical value calculations and control, while virtual reality technology is a high-powered visual and interactive simulation technology. The paper discusses how to combine the two.

articleTitle: Efficient control of an induction motor based on the decoupling variable structure strategy
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Based on the decoupling model of an induction motor, a new approach of variable structure is proposed by utilizing the reaching law. A new control strategy for the induction motor is proposed to improve the system efficiency. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach to improve the system performance and robustness.

articleTitle: Nine-point controller
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper introduces the nine-point controller. The strategies of nine-point controller are based on the analysis of the mechanism of the system state near the set value. The nine-point controller adopts nine control rules according to nine working conditions in the phase plane of the error and error rate. Also, typical control rules of a multi-mode output nine-point controller is introduced.

articleTitle: The research of adaptive algorithm of smart antenna arrays in the CDMA system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: With the development of cellular mobile communication, CDMA technologies are making giant steps in commercial wireless markets across the world. The smart antenna in the CDMA cellular mobile communication system can be used to reduce the interference and improve the system performance. This paper gives an overview of some general concepts for smart antennas with focuses on the adaptive algorithm according to the characteristics of mobile users and antenna arrays.

articleTitle: A class of model framework of combat simulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In this paper, we illustrated the shortcomings of combat model (Lanchester equations), introduced the development of combat simulation recently, proposed the approach of combat simulation and modeling and a kind of abstract structure of weapon platform based on complex systems theory. In the last, we provided a combat example to illustrate our approach in details.

articleTitle: The application of a distributed system-level diagnosis algorithm in dynamic positioning system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper introduces the application of a distributed system-level fault diagnosis algorithm for detecting and diagnosing faulty processors in dynamic positioning system (DPS) of an offshore vessel. The system architecture of DPS is a loose coupling distributed multiprocessor system, which adopts the technique of Intel's MULTIBUS II and develops a software application on the platform of iRMX OS. In this paper a new approach to the diagnosis problem is presented, including an adaptive PMC model, distributed diagnosis including self-diagnosis and interactive-diagnosis, and system graph-theoretic model. The self-diagnosis fully utilises the individual results of built-in self-tests as a part of diagnosis work. Interactive-diagnosis means that in the system fault-free units perform simple periodic tests on one another under the direction of the graph-theoretic model by interactively communicating, and every unit can only send the diagnosis information to its considered fault-free units. Finally, we illustrate the procedure of diagnosis verification. The results obtained show that the adaptive PMC model is applicable, the distributed system-level diagnosis algorithm is proper, and the applications of diagnosis and verification are reliable and practicable.

articleTitle: A case-based reinforcement learning for probe robot path planning
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper discusses the application of case-based learning for probe robot path planning in unknown environments. Case-based learning which makes use of past experience, is an incremental learning process. This paper proposes an algorithm of introducing reinforcement learning to case-based-reasoning, which makes full use of knowledge acquired by reinforcement learning to construct and extend the case-library. This method can enhance the adaptability of robot to unknown environments and solve the problem of case acquiring as well as poor real-time performance, high learning risk of reinforcement learning. Also, with the forget-rule, case-library can be updated in time so that efficiency of case searching and learning is increased. As the learning progressing and the case-library dynamically updated, robot's intelligence has been greatly improved. A simulation shows the validity and feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: The study of detection technology and instrument of buried pipeline-coating defects
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Based on a study of electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) of buried pipeline coating defects, a detection method for coating defects is put forward, a DSP-based measurement instrument is developed, and satisfactory results are acquired on an experimental pipeline and long transport pipelines.

articleTitle: Intelligent control method and application of cation reverse flotation process
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: According to the complexity of the controlled object, uncertainty of its mathematical model and high requirements of its control quality, this paper introduces an intelligent control method for the cation reverse flotation process. With this method, the system can satisfy the technological requirements.

articleTitle: Structure optimization of wavelet neural network using rough set theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper presents an approach to minimize the redundancy of structure existing in frame-based wavelet neural networks using the rough sets theory. The original structure of the wavelet network is obtained through a time-frequency analysis. Then the redundant nodes are eliminated in light of the dependency between the output of the network and nodes in the hidden layers to optimize the structure of the wavelet network. Simulation results show the proposed method is simple and effective.

articleTitle: TWS tracking techniques based on adaptive Gaussian mixture model in phased array radar
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In this paper, an on-line real-time tracking algorithm for radar image sequences is proposed. First, a GMM (Gaussian mixture model) is used to approximate values of a particular pixel of the radar image sequences, parameters of the GMM are updated each time. Then, we use a simple heuristic to hypothesize which Gaussian of the mixture is most likely to be part of the adaptive background model. After the background model is established, pixel values that don't match the pixel "background" Gaussians are grouped using connected components. Features of the targets such as center position, size, radial and angular velocities are also computed in the mean time. Finally, the connected components are tracked across frames using a Kalman filter-based tracker. The experimental result shows that the algorithm is robust in clutter and easy to implement on-line.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional calibration of micro-manipulator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A project that realized micron-grade-calibration in three-dimensional millimeter-grade-space is developed. The operational principle, calculation methods and the requirement for the calibration module are stated. Results of a real example are given.

articleTitle: Implement of a RoboCup small-size robot system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: RoboCup is an increasingly developed international high-tech based match to promote AI, robotics, and related fields. As an item of the whole project, the small-size group is a hardware based match. This paper discusses the robots system implement of such a match. At first, we introduce the RoboCup match and the research of our country. Then the small-size group rules are given in brief. After this, two main architectures of the implement are analyzed: the global vision system and the distributed vision system. At last, based upon above analysis,we bring forward our implement: an omni-direction based global vision system, and indicate the future work.

articleTitle: Analysis of kinematical performance of micro soccer robot
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: As the player of robot soccer, the kinematical performance of soccer robot influences directly the execution of move instructions. It reflects also the design level of soccer robot. In order to improve the kinematical performance of micro soccer robot, deep analysis is made in this paper. It examines all factors affecting the performance. After solving successfully the under-restraint equations, the paper presents some useful results such as the best driving mode of the robot and the biggest driving force, etc, which are very important to the design of micro robot with high kinematical performances.

articleTitle: Intelligent information agent with ontology on the semantic Web
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The paper introduces the new technology of the semantic Web that can facilitate intelligent applications for information processing on the Web. It describes the architecture of the semantic Web and its supporting technologies such as resource description framework (RDF) and ontology. The paper shows the integration of agent technology and ontology may make significant impact on the use of Web services and the ability to extend programs to more efficiently perform tasks for users with less human intervention. It presents the implement of Web service search by ontology-based intelligent agent.

articleTitle: Interpolation based kernel function's constructing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The kernel function is important for support vector machines (SVMs) in classification and regression. However, how to select a kernel function for the given data is still an open problem. Many papers are limited to consult the properties of some standard kernel functions. Since the effect of kernel mapping has not been understood very clearly, the result may not be as good as SVM should be in some cases. We present a method with interpolation and the subspace method to construct a kernel function according to the given data. The experiments showed that the kernel function constructed using our method has predominance of generalization in the case that the training data is too small.

articleTitle: Implementation of distributed intelligent control system based on multi-agents
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: It is necessary to implement distributed intelligent control systems (DICS) because of the demand of large scaled and complexity control systems in industry processes. The characteristics of traditional control systems and DICS are described. A DICS model of a complex industrial process is set up by using multi-agents, and a kind of distributed intelligent multiobjective optimal algorithm is proposed. The multi-agent system is created according to the practical characteristics of the control system of a digester process. It is integrated by using CORBA, and the simulation result of a practical digester process is shown.

articleTitle: The research and realization of full redundancy technology in LON monitoring and control network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The paper briefly describes the reliability measure of control network, and discusses the common methods of redundancy technology. The paper conducts the research of full redundancy architecture according to the features of LON system, gives the detailed redundancy realization method in each level. Finally, the paper analyses the usability of the method discussed in the context.

articleTitle: Learning and approximate inference of DBNs
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In this paper, the techniques for learning and approximate inference of dynamic Bayesian networks (DBNs) are studied. With respect to the structure learning of DBNs, the EM-EA algorithm is introduced into the learning process of DBNs and the flow of learning DBNs is given out in the presence of the incomplete data and hidden variables. As for the DBNs inference, the difficulties are analyzed that apply directly the standard inference techniques to DBNs. Furthermore, two improved algorithms of likelihood weighting (LW) algorithm, ER algorithm and SOF algorithm are introduced and assembled. The experimental results show that these algorithms can effectively overcome the disadvantages of the LW algorithm, and especially, the assembled algorithm gives a outstanding performance.

articleTitle: Robot motion simulation with eigen space method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Proposes a technique of robot motion simulation with imaged-based view synthesis. An eigen space method is used to acquire appearance representations of images, which can capture all possible variations in object shape, surface reflection, illumination etc. According to the given robot joint positions, the trajectory in the joint space is first planned to generate a joint sequence, and the image sequence of the robot motion is synthesized directly from reference images, not requiring a priori a CAD model or any calibration. Virtual motion results of the robot UP6 are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Path planning of robot using genetic annealing algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The paper presents a new approach, which uses genetic annealing algorithm to solve multi-robot path planning in dynamic environment. The algorithm avoids the common defect of early convergence in genetic algorithm, and can converge faster than simulated annealing algorithm or genetic algorithm alone. We have designed an effective path planning crossover operator pointing to the characteristics of complex environment. Simulation and real experiment results show that the method is effective in multi-robot path planning.

articleTitle: The real-time detection technology of city traffic condition based-on GPS system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The Global Positioning System (GPS) is the most popular satellite positioning system in the world at present. From the development of GPS and current traffic condition monitoring methods, the paper presents a new detection method of traffic condition based on the GPS technology. It can derive conveniently the driving time, demand velocity of vehicles and driveway occupancy, and obtain the distribution function of velocity by means of fitting velocity values of short time periods, and the time mean of velocity by quadrature. The traffic volume is calculated by an interval mean of velocity, realizing a real-time detection of the traffic condition. This has important signification to city traffic induction and control, offering a necessary condition for the realization of an intelligent transportation system.

articleTitle: A new algorithm of uncorrelated discriminant vectors and its application
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A study has been made on the method of solving an optimal set of uncorrelated discriminant vectors. We have made an improvement to the method of solving an optimal set of uncorrelated discriminant vectors of Zhong Jin et al. (2001) on the basis of the equivalence of two Fisher criteria. A concise formula for solving the optimal set of uncorrelated discriminant vectors has been proposed. Numerical experiments on the facial database of ORL show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A fixed-lag smoothing algorithm for Markovian switching systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A suboptimal approach to the fixed-lag smoothing problem for Markovian switching systems is presented. We augmented the system state and system model probability, so the fixed-lag smoothing problem is transformed to the filtering problem of a new augmented system. A new fixed-lag smoothing algorithm is developed by applying the basic structure of IMM, which is superior in MME methods, to the augmented systems. The algorithm is illustrated via two typical target tracking simulation examples, where a significant improvement over Chen's algorithm is achieved at the cost of a time delay.

articleTitle: A new approach to recover depth information by microscopic image processing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A new approach to recover depth information by microscopic image processing is put forward and implemented in the paper. Firstly, an optical model for microscopic imaging is given. Secondly, a scheme to identify the spread parameters of the microscope by use of face objects is put forward. Then, the analytical solution of the optical model is given for rectangular face objects. Furthermore, an experiment is designed and carried out to set up a mapping between the spread parameter /spl sigma/ of the microscope and Z-axis coordinates. The mapping is finally obtained by using a genetic algorithm to search experiment data. Finally, the result above is applied to a virtual environment for micro operation with the features of microscopic image.

articleTitle: A new fuzzy neural network for nonlinear approaching
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: With the aim of a general approaching problem of nonlinear mapping, a general sub-field approaching algorithm is suggested to realize global field approaching, on the basis of which a new fuzzy neural network is configured to carry out the suggested algorithm. The authors compare this new fuzzy neural network with the BP neural network via simulation and the RBF neural network. The results indicate that the approaching ability of this new FNN is obviously superior to the latter two, and the weights have distinct geometric meaning and the design difficulty is relatively small. Accordingly, this new FNN can be used to approach any complicated nonlinear functions.

articleTitle: VaR and its application in civil aviation transportation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Risk analyses are important problems in revenue management in civil aviation transportation. Uncertainty of the return resulted from the seat rate is a key to risk analyses. Based on the method of managing risk, VaR is applied to manage risk and return in civil aviation transportation. By giving definition of change rate of seat, the calculating methods of VaR about single-line multi-line and about the whole civil aviation company are given. Finally, the validity of VaR applying in the risk management of civil aviation transportation is verified through an example.

articleTitle: An evolution computation approach to hybrid dynamic system optimal control problems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper deals with optimal control problems of hybrid dynamic systems. Since the solution of such complex problems has comprehensive applications in practice, a generic approach based on genetic algorithms is proposed in this paper to effectively handle the continuous-time and discrete-event dynamics with multiple optimization objectives. A multitank blending system control problem is presented as a case study to show the implementation of the proposed method. The results demonstrate that this approach has the theoretical significance, and the promising prospects due to the comprehensive applications in practice.

articleTitle: A multi-agent and holonic approach for intelligent scheduling in agile manufacturing environments
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: An agile production scheduling system is developed using the notion which combines the multi-agent paradigm and the holonic manufacturing concept. A system framework with several "holonic-agents" is described firstly to show how the two paradigms are amalgamated. Then the distributed ruler based mechanism is proposed to coordinate behaviors of these holonic-agents in order to realize a predictable and nearly optimal scheduling with agility and adaptability. The object-oriented and CORBA based technique is also discussed briefly to construct a prototype system for the presented approach. Satisfactory conclusions are drawn from experiments and a short analysis of them is given at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: A study of air-fuel ratio and EGR control system for LPG engines
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper describes the structure of fuel supply system for LPG engines. Based on the method of grey forecasting, the air-fuel ratio of the engine is controlled. Furthermore, the model of back-propagation network is established and the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) flow rate is controlled. The experimental results show that this control system improves the performance, fuel economy and emissions of LPG engines.

articleTitle: Eigenstructure assignment for stabilizable linear systems via state feedback
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In this paper, a direct and explicit parametric solution of the matrix equation AV+BW=VF is proposed. Here [A B] is not required to be controllable. When [A B] is controllable, the solution obtained is a result previously obtained by Duan (1993). Based on the proposed solution of this matrix equation, a parametric approach for eigenstructure assignment in stabilizable linear systems via state feedback is established. The obtained result generalizes the approach proposed previously by Duan to the case with uncontrollable modes.

articleTitle: The design scheme and chip selection of PXI bus based high-speed data acquisition module
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper describes the features and advantages of PXI bus. It introduces PXI bus based high-speed DAQ module in the design idea, scheme, working process and chip selection.

articleTitle: A logistic cellular automaton for simulating tumor growth
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper focuses on simulating tumor growth with cellular automaton (CA), in which a one-dimensional CA is designed based on the logistic model. First, a discrete logistic model is derived from the continuous logistic model and implemented with the one-dimensional CA. And then, the random evolution rules of CA are derived according to the discrete model. Finally, a CA model is applied to simulate tumor growth. Theoretic analysis and experimental results of the one-dimensional CA are in good agreement with the data from the ideal logistic growth of cancer.

articleTitle: New boosting algorithms for text categorization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: AdaBoost.SZ is a boosting method specifically designed for solving multi-class, multi-label text categorization problems. Fabrizio Sebastiani et al. (2000) provided another idea to improve these base classifiers: combining two or more weak hypotheses as a single base classifier. Its main problem is that the amount of hypotheses selected to combine is determined not by their importance, but by the boosting iteration times already performed. This paper proposes two dynamical ways for combining any number of hypotheses according to their importance. Experimental results show that the new ideas do improve the performance of boosting.

articleTitle: Simulation and application research on a repetitive control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: When reference input or disturbance to be eliminated is period signal, repetitive control, in theory, can track reference input without stead-state error or can eliminate disturbance. This paper is about a deeper simulation research of a modified repetitive control system and is implemented on a computer controlled DC servomotor system. Simulation and actual experience both prove the good performance of repetitive control technique.

articleTitle: Solving orbit maintenance problems by the synthesis of evolution algorithms and traditional optimization methods
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Orbit maintenance problems are solved by the synthesis of the traditional penalty function method and evolution algorithms (EAs). A general method is presented for the n-time impulse problem of orbit maintenance. The algorithm is proved to be effective according to a simulation example which adjusts the semi-major axis with 3,4,5 impulse times.

articleTitle: Realizing the fault diagnostic system in maglev suspension train system (MSTS) based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Since maglev train system is a large system, it is difficult to diagnose the fault to the whole train extent by traditional method of fault diagnosing. The fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method is usually applied to most large systems, which can consider many factors of a large system. Firstly the principle of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method is introduced, then concerned about the feature of programme logical controller (PLC), it is applied to the fault diagnostic system of MSTS. In the end the data of the experiment is analyzed and this method is proved to be proper in fault diagnostic system of MSTS.

articleTitle: Sampled-data iterative learning control for singular systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Sampled-data iterative learning control (SILC) for singular systems is addressed for the first time. With the introduction of the constrained relative degree, an SILC algorithm combined with a feedback control law is proposed for singular systems. Convergence of the algorithm is proved in sup-norm, while the conventional convergence analysis is in /spl lambda/-norm. The final tracking error uniformly converges to a small residual set whose level of magnitude depends on the system dynamics and the sampling-period. Inequalities to estimate the level the existing results of SILC, convergence is guaranteed not only at the sampling instants but on the entire operation interval, thus the inter-sample behavior guaranteed, which is more practical for real implementation.

articleTitle: A research and application of auto-optimize and fuzzy control for black liquor combustion in alkali recovery boiler
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The functions of alkali recovery boiler are to generate steam and to recover soda by burning the black liquid produced in the kraft pulp process. According to its characteristics, this paper focuses on the method combined with auto-optimization techniques with the fuzzy logic to adjust the first and second gas quantity for controlling the temperatures of the furnace and black ash pad, which are measured by an infrared thermoscope. The control system is composed of a computer network.. The result shows that the application of this intelligent method can improve the thermal efficiency and increase the alkali recovery ratio in the furnace.

articleTitle: Input estimation for uncertain linear singular systems and robust stabilization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In this paper, the problem of state and input estimation for linear singular systems with unknown inputs is concerned. An equivalent standard state spaces system is derived for the purpose of the observer design. The necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of, the observer and the simple method to design the observer are given. The robust stability of the closed-loop obtained by dynamic output feedback is also discussed.

articleTitle: An optimal neural network speed estimator using genetic algorithms
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In direct torque control system, a speed-estimating method based on an optimal neural network using genetic algorithms is presented to estimate the rotor speed of asynchronous motors. According to the equations of asynchronous motors, the equation of speed is gotten, a speed estimator model based on recursive neural networks is also gotten, and genetic algorithms optimize the speed estimator. The simulation result shows the optimized speed estimator can track accurately the variation of speed, and the system has better dynamic performance.

articleTitle: Using cellular automata as heuristic of computer Go
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Based on the essential similarity of the cellular automata (CA) and the game of Go, this paper proposes a CA-based candidate move generator (GoCA) as well as the correlative knowledge represent method. A scheme for computer Go is also propounded. In which, GoCA perform the task of learning rules from expert game records, and then as a heuristic method, it combines with the minimax search to prune volume branches from the game tree. The experimental result shows the feasibility of anchoring our hope on it to improve the competitive ability of computer Go.

articleTitle: Simulation of car-following decision based on wavelet neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Car-following is a kind of driving behavior which is difficult to be expressed precisely, and is influenced by multiple factors. In this paper, on the basis of using various information around a driver sufficiently, wavelet neural network is utilized to simulate car-following behavior in single lane and generates reliable simulation outcomes.

articleTitle: Key technology on off-turning degree in resonant grounding power network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A new method to measure off-turning degree of resonant grounding power network is introduced in the paper. According to the new method, off-turning degree auto-measuring system controlled by computer has been designed and the error of measurement results has been analyzed. Not only did the system keep the error within 0.64%, but also improve measuring precision apparently. The measuring method is simply operated and don't need any other key parameters. With good character of real time, the time of measuring procedure is not more than 20 s. By the active eliminator, power network can work in good condition separately from system testing. Automatic and intelligent measurement of off-turning degree has been realized online.

articleTitle: Analytical structure of fuzzy controllers with adjusting membership function or control rules
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In this paper, we analytically derive the structure of the fuzzy controllers with different triangular-shaped membership functions and rules adjusting, which are commonly used in the design of fuzzy controllers. The relations between these adjusting and the properties of fuzzy controllers are discussed then. This approach can be used as a reference for the analysis and design of fuzzy controllers.

articleTitle: A multi-robot system based on distributed coordination
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The paper presents the architecture of a distributed multi-robot system including the VxWorks distributed real-time operating system for the CRS F3 robot system, the Host-Target type computer system, a multi-functional software module, and an Internet oriented Web server. The paper focuses on the distributed coordination control of the system, and proposes an effective solution to deal with the control and communication problems.

articleTitle: Research on multidimensional-cube simplification algorithm of logical functions
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A method of logical functions simplification is presented, based on fundamental studies of the algorithm according to the multidimensional-cube representation method for the logical functions. Compared with the other algorithms, this algorithm can avoid the unnecessary computation and memory effectively and improve the speed of simplification. The author proves the effectiveness of the new method by experiments. This algorithm has a broad application in EDA.

articleTitle: Modeling of an optical fiber sensor with piezoelectric ZnO coating
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: An electrical model of the optical fiber acousto-optic sensor (OFS) coated with piezoelectric ZnO has been presented. The geometry of the optical fiber using ZnO coating has been firstly described and the basic theory of piezoelectric resonator of this geometry been analyzed. Then full details for the development of the electrical model based on the actual cylindrical nature of OFS have been discussed. An excellent agreement exists between the model simulation results and experimental measurements.

articleTitle: Simulated robotic hot-line maintenance based on virtual reality
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: We construct a simulation system for a live line maintenance robot using virtual reality. The simulation system uses the same input devices and controllers as a real robot system. It provides functions of operator training, human-machine intelligent control simulation, and robotic trajectory simulation. Those simulation data can activate the real robot. The simulation system framework and modeling methods of the virtual world are described in the paper. An experimental simulation result shows the validity of the proposed system.

articleTitle: Distributed position control method for a hyper-redundant modular manipulator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: According to the multi-agent system theory and characteristics of the structural distribution of hyper-redundant modular manipulator, we establish the distributed control system for a hyper-redundant modular manipulator. Each of the joint module is considered as an intelligent agent. Since the relations among agents are tightly coupled and each agent has no local subtask, agents need to coordinate their actions constantly in order to complete their tasks. We present a new negotiation and cooperation control algorithm. The proposed method is applied to a 2-dimensional hyper-redundant modular manipulator with rotational joints. The effectiveness of the method are confirmed by computer simulations.

articleTitle: Research on distributed load control for DIN
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The chief bottleneck is the capability that SCPs deal with services and communicate with SSPs in traditional intelligent networks (IN). As technologies evolved, researchers have presented the distributed IN (DIN) for overcoming the bottleneck problem. This paper presents a cost-based distributed adaptive load control model and its load control algorithm based on DIN. And then, the emulation results and its analysis are given.

articleTitle: Study of attraction domain and exponential convergence rate of Hopfield continuous dynamic feedback neural nets
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The attraction domain of memory patterns and exponential convergence rate of the network trajectories to memory patterns for Hopfield continuous dynamic feedback neural nets are estimated by using analytical techniques and a new Lyapunov function. Some new results are obtained, and the results can be used for the evaluation of fault-tolerance capability and synthesis procedures of Hopfield continuous dynamic feedback neural nets.

articleTitle: Stability analysis for nonlinear feedback control systems with linear actuators
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Often nonlinear feedback controllers are implemented with linear actuators, which have faster dynamics compared with the nonlinear dynamics of the plant and controller models. But how much faster should the dynamics of the linear actuator be to ensure stability of the given nonlinear feedback control system? The paper gives an analysis for the underlying stability issues, and provides quantitative measures for the linear actuators, employed in nonlinear feedback control systems.

articleTitle: The research of characteristics and foundation technologies of diagnosis system based on DAI in the Web
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Distributed artificial intelligence (DAI) has been developed rapidly in industrial application. In this paper, we present a web-based distributed intelligent diagnosis system based on the DAI theory for parallel and cooperative approaches in solving complex diagnostic problems. We first describe the characteristics of the agent and multi-agent systems. Then we analyze the feasibility of applying the agent theory to the diagnosis systems. The characteristics of task processing in the system are described. Four foundation technologies are discussed according to the implementation levels. We presents the general steps of developing a diagnosis system based on the DAI theory.

articleTitle: Research on enterprise modeling architecture and supporting tool for agile manufacturing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: Global market environment and integrated region economy greatly challenge global manufacturing. As a typical representative of advanced manufacturing modes, agile manufacturing becomes the reform and reorganization guidance of enterprises in the 21/sup st/ century because of its agile product development and management method. Based on the agility connotation of agile manufacturing, this paper proposes an agile enterprise modeling architecture, which can support the establishment of an agile manufacturing enterprise model fast and efficiently. Furthermore, the object-oriented agile manufacturing enterprise modeling method is also presented. Finally, the framework of modeling supporting tool is elaborated.

articleTitle: A human simulating mechanism for Chinese information filtering
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In this paper, a mechanism of Chinese text filtering is proposed, which combines two analysis methods, top-down analysis (driven by expectation) with down-top analysis (driven by language), by analyzing and simulating human thought and behavior in manual filtering. Also, the traditional statistical method and syntax analysis of Chinese text are united by the mechanism. This technique can improve both efficiency and precision of the text filtering system.

articleTitle: The application of wavelet theory and fuzzy recognition technology in signal processing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: The paper presents a new method based on the wavelet theory and fuzzy recognition technology for the first time to analyze body dynamic blood pressure signal. The method of edge extending is adopted in order to eliminate edge effect in signal pre-processing; the ability of signal characters extracting is enhanced greatly because of application of DWT and CWT; the fuzzy recognition technology introduced by the paper achieves accurate recognition signal. It is tested the method is effective and practical.

articleTitle: A new error-correcting decoder for fast correcting codes with multi-bit errors
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: This paper introduced a new error-correcting technology with strong correcting ability in digital signal transmission. We propose a decoding method by shortening the code and full combination logic instead of using a lot of shifting registers as we do in the traditional error-correcting circuit. As a result, the error-correcting circuit is simplified and the error-correcting time is greatly shortened. We provide the equation and method of fast coding, error discovery and decoding, as well as the circuit structure for error-correcting.

articleTitle: Modeling and stability analysis of multi-area interconnected power systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: In this paper, a mathematical model of multi-area interconnected power systems with deviation form is established in state spaces based on the system features and control requirements of decentralized AGC. The Riccati equation method of stability analysis is adopted to obtain the stability conditions of this kind of systems. These conditions can be described by subsystems completely and be applied to practice very easily.

articleTitle: Processing of unperfected experimental data
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
abstract: A synthetic approach to processing the experimental data is discussed in this paper. The mathematical statistics, fuzzy mathematics and artificial neural network technique are synthesized together in order to process a kind of unperfected experimental data, and a mathematical model in the shape of fuzzy neural networks is built. This method then is used to process the experimental data obtained from a complicated chemical reaction. The actual results have proved that this approach is simple, practical and effective. The model obtained by the method mentioned above can be used in further simulation and optimization study of the reaction process.

articleTitle: A sensory reflexive control for humanoid walking
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 4th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (Cat. No.02EX527)
